```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Objective

Assess performance of fragment model. 

### Input
-*reviewed_fragments_labl_2020_tuning.xlsx* (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments)
List of fragments manually reviewed. Examples of classes are here:
https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1iwTvRggTpLgBiylU861lNOKbjS_VIrJVO9CK5awc4l8/edit?usp=sharing

### Output
- *single_metrics_labl_2020_tuning.json*
Performance metrics for detecting single fragments
- *duplicate_metrics_labl_2020_tuning.json*
Performance metrics for detecting duplicates 
- *corrected_fragments_labl_2020_tuning.json* 
List of fragments with duplicate classification corrected - can be used as a "human-in-the-loop" alternative for downstreams processing

### Issues/Deviations/Comments
The tuning_labl_2020 set was used for setting thresholds for the fragment model and the performance in it should thus be taken with a grain of salt. 
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)

reviewed <- read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/fragments/input/reviewed_fragments_labl_2020_tuning.xlsx")

output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/fragments/output/validate_fragments/"


#Calculate metrics for duplicate identification

reviewed_duplicate <- reviewed %>%
  mutate(duplicates_confusion = case_when(classification == "duplicate_fragment" & is.na(correction) ~ "TP",
                                          classification != "duplicate_fragment" & is.na(correction) ~ "TN",
                                          classification == "duplicate_fragment" & correction == "included_fragment" ~ "FP",
                                          classification != "duplicate_fragment" & correction == "duplicate" ~ "FN",
                                          TRUE ~ NA))

# Filter out NAs
filtered <- reviewed_duplicate[!is.na(reviewed_duplicate$duplicates_confusion), ]

# Create confusion matrix counts
TP <- sum(filtered$duplicates_confusion == "TP")
TN <- sum(filtered$duplicates_confusion == "TN")
FP <- sum(filtered$duplicates_confusion == "FP")
FN <- sum(filtered$duplicates_confusion == "FN")

# Compute metrics
sensitivity <- TP / (TP + FN)
specificity <- TN / (TN + FP)
ppv <- TP / (TP + FP)  # Positive Predictive Value
npv <- TN / (TN + FN)  # Negative Predictive Value
balanced_accuracy <- (sensitivity + specificity) / 2
f1_score <- 2 * TP / (2 * TP + FP + FN)

# Create a result table
duplicate_metrics <- data.frame(
  Sensitivity = sensitivity,
  Specificity = specificity,
  PPV = ppv,
  NPV = npv,
  Balanced_Accuracy = balanced_accuracy,
  F1_Score = f1_score
)

write_json(duplicate_metrics, paste0(output_dir, "duplicate_metrics_labl_2020_tuning.json"), pretty = TRUE)

fragments_corrected <- reviewed_duplicate%>%
  mutate(classification = case_when(correction == "duplicate" ~ "duplicate_fragment",
                                    correction == "included_fragment" ~ "included_fragment",
                                    is.na(correction) ~ classification,
                                    TRUE ~ NA)) %>%
  select(image_name, fragment_name, classification, fragment_area_um2, comment)

write_json(fragments_corrected, paste0(output_dir, "corrected_fragments_labl_2020_tuning.json"), pretty=TRUE)

fragments_corrected_single <- fragments_corrected %>%
  mutate(single_confusion = case_when(is.na(comment) ~ "TP",
                                     comment == "missed" ~ "FN",
                                     (comment == "split" | comment == "multiple" | comment == "part") ~ "FP",
                                     TRUE ~ NA))

filtered <- fragments_corrected_single %>% filter(classification == "included_fragment")

TP <- sum(filtered$single_confusion == "TP")
FP <- sum(filtered$single_confusion == "FP")
FN <- sum(filtered$single_confusion == "FN")

sensitivity <- TP / (TP + FN)
ppv <- TP / (TP + FP)  # Positive Predictive Value
f1_score <- 2 * TP / (2 * TP + FP + FN)

single_metrics <- data.frame(
  Sensitivity = sensitivity,
  PPV = ppv,
  F1_Score = f1_score
)

write_json(single_metrics, paste0(output_dir, "single_metrics_labl_2020_tuning.json"), pretty = TRUE)
```
